journal_storage_dir.description: Directory where persistent journal files are stored. Set to `volatile` or `auto` for runtime-only storage.

journal_system_max_use.description: Maximum disk space used by system journal files (e.g., '100M', '1G', '5%').

journal_system_max_file_size.description: Maximum size of individual journal files before rotation.

journal_system_keep_free.description: Space to keep free on the disk for other uses (e.g., '10%', '500M').

journal_sync_interval_sec.description: Time interval (in seconds) between syncs to disk. Increase for better performance, decrease for durability.

journal_max_file_sec.description: Maximum time a journal file is kept before rotation.

syslog_forward_to_socket.description: If true, legacy syslog messages are forwarded to the journald stream socket (`StreamSocket`).

forward_to_journal.description: Whether to forward received messages to the systemd journal (most systems should keep this enabled).

forward_to_kmsg.description: If true, messages are forwarded to the kernel log buffer (`dmesg`).

forward_to_console.description: If true, messages are output to the system console (use only if needed for debugging).

journal_runtime_journal_dir.description: Directory for runtime-only journal files (volatile storage).

journal_system_journal_dir.description: Directory for persistent system journal files.

syslog_stream_socket.description: Unix stream socket path for receiving legacy syslog messages.

items.description: Additional structured field names to expose in the stream socket (e.g., `SYSLOG_FACILITY`, `SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER`).

stream_socket_extra_fields.description: List of extra fields to include in stream socket entries (use for advanced parsing).

rate_limit_interval_sec.description: Time window (seconds) for rate limiting incoming log messages.

rate_limit_burst.description: Maximum number of messages allowed per rate-limit interval.

compress.description: If true, compress old journal files using XZ (requires xz-utils).

log_level.description: Verbosity level for internal journald logging.

log_facility.description: List of syslog facilities to accept from the stream socket.

readahead_max_threads.description: Maximum number of threads used for readahead optimization.

binary_journal.description: If false, use plain-text journal format (not recommended for production).

journal_max_entries.description: Maximum number of journal entries retained in memory per journal.

journal_max_entries_sec.description: Maximum time (seconds) entries are held in memory before being flushed to disk.

journal_user_max_entries.description: Maximum number of entries retained per user session.
